title: VendPoint Merchandising Schedule: Wear Allowance for Substitute Items
content:
Merchandising schedule of the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program for a substitute Corbett places in a retired item's selection. The category is read from the substitute's line in the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement.

The wear allowance follows the product category on the substitute's contract price line: an item in the safety and PPE category carries the PPE wear allowance, an item in the cutting tools or the abrasives category carries the consumable wear allowance, and any other item carries none.

| Category on the substitute's contract price line | Wear allowance |
|---|---|
| Safety and PPE | 0.5 (PPE wear allowance) |
| Cutting tools | 0.25 (consumable wear allowance) |
| Abrasives | 0.25 (consumable wear allowance) |
| Any other category | None |

The substitute's contract price line is the line written as a Corbett-approved substitute for a discontinued item carrying the highest change reference. Hypothetical examples: a substitute ear defender listed under safety and PPE carries 0.5; a substitute pipe fitting listed under plumbing carries none.
